description: Source code for the Linux kernel driver handling TMU (Traffic Management Unit) functionalities for the siflower Ethernet device, including register access, port, queue, scheduler, and shaper configurations.

methods.name: u32 tmu_rm32(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 reg,u32 mask,u32 shift)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from a register, applies a mask and shift.

methods.name: void tmu_rmw32(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 reg,u32 mask,u32 shift,u32 val)
methods.description: Read-modify-write operation on a 32-bit register with mask and shift.

methods.name: int is_valid_port_idx(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port)
methods.description: Checks if a port index is within range.

methods.name: int is_valid_queue_idx(u32 q)
methods.description: Checks if a queue index is within range.

methods.name: int is_valid_sched_idx(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 sched)
methods.description: Checks if a scheduler index is within range.

methods.name: int is_valid_shaper_idx(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 shaper)
methods.description: Checks if a shaper index is within range.

methods.name: int tmu_port_writel(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 reg,u32 val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a port register after validation.

methods.name: int tmu_port_rm32(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 reg,u32 mask,u32 shift,u32 * val)
methods.description: Reads a 32-bit value from a port register after validation.

methods.name: int tmu_port_rmw32(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 reg,u32 mask,u32 shift,u32 val)
methods.description: Read-modify-write on a port register after validation.

methods.name: int tmu_queue_writel(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 queue,u32 reg,u32 val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a queue register.

methods.name: int tmu_sched_writel(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 sched,u32 reg,u32 val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a scheduler register.

methods.name: int tmu_shaper_writel(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 shaper,u32 reg,u32 val)
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit value to a shaper register.

methods.name: int tmu_shaper_rmw32(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port,u32 shaper,u32 reg,u32 mask,u32 shift,u32 val)
methods.description: Read-modify-write on a shaper register.

methods.name: int tdq_ctrl_is_configurable(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port)
methods.description: Checks if the port's queue configuration is configurable.

methods.name: void tmu_port_queue_cfg(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port)
methods.description: Configures the queues for a specific port.

methods.name: void tmu_port_sched_cfg(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port)
methods.description: Configures schedulers for a specific port.

methods.name: void tmu_port_shaper_cfg(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port)
methods.description: Configures shapers for a specific port.

methods.name: void _tmu_reset(struct dpns_priv * priv,u32 port)
methods.description: Resets and configures a specific port.

methods.name: int tmu_reset(struct dpns_priv * priv)
methods.description: Resets all ports of the TMU.

methods.name: int dpns_tmu_init(struct dpns_priv * priv)
methods.description: Initializes the TMU hardware component.
